    parent_map = case['parent']

    # Compute stability for each retained cluster

        birth = cl['birth_lambda']
        stability = sum(max(0, exit - birth) for exit in cl['point_exit_lambdas'])
        cl['stability'] = stability
    
    # Create list of candidates sorted by (-stability, cluster_id)
    candidates = sorted(retained.keys(), key=lambda cid: (-retained[cid]['stability'], cid))
    
    selected = []
    blocked = set()  # set of cluster IDs that are ancestors of a selected cluster
    
    # Helper to get all retained ancestors of a cluster (excluding itself)
    def get_retained_ancestors(cid):
        ancestors = []
        cur = parent_map.get(cid)
        while cur is not None:
            if cur in retained:
                ancestors.append(cur)
            cur = parent_map.get(cur)
        return ancestors
    
    # Helper to check if any descendant (in retained tree) is selected

        # DFS over retained children

            stack.extend(children.get(node, []))
        return False
    
    selected_set = set()  # for quick lookup

        if cid in blocked:
            continue
        if has_selected_descendant(cid):
            continue
        # Select this cluster
        selected.append(cid)
        selected_set.add(cid)
        # Block its retained ancestors
        ancestors = get_retained_ancestors(cid)
        blocked.update(ancestors)
